array.string: mkdir -p "${HOME}/Library/Logs" && cd "${COMPOUND_REPO:?set COMPOUND_REPO}" && bun tools/asc_daily_signals.ts --config "${COMPOUND_ASC_PRODUCTS:?set COMPOUND_ASC_PRODUCTS}" --asc-command "${COMPOUND_ASC_DAILY_COMMAND:?set COMPOUND_ASC_DAILY_COMMAND}" --date "$(date -v-1d +%F)" --out-dir "${COMPOUND_HOME:-${HOME}/.compound}/state/asc-daily-signals" --apply --json >>"${HOME}/Library/Logs/ai.compound.asc-daily.out.log" 2>>"${HOME}/Library/Logs/ai.compound.asc-daily.err.log"
